id: HL-07 a 40,000-character line of list markers is measured in linear time: one whose last marker is followed by 6 columns leaves its section as written, one of plain items is fixed and written (0.1.7 polish)
note: 0.1.7 polish (integration review of 0.1.6). code_sections re-measured the whole prefix for each leading list marker of a line, so a line of n markers took n squared steps: a 10,001-character `- - … x` took 2.5 s, 40,000 characters about 40 s per call. A running column keeps it linear. The first publish holds 20,000 `- ` markers and a last `-` followed by 6 columns (an indented code block, measured past the long prefix): the section stays as written and its range blocks, the plain Next steps range is listed. The second holds the same markers followed by text: plain items, so the range is listed and the handoff is written. Each publish must finish within 8 s (it took 40 s before).
